name: git-guardrails
description: Blocks irreversible git operations: force pushes to protected branches, hard resets over uncommitted work, protected branch deletion and history rewrites.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Branches the agent may not force push, delete or commit to directly. Glob patterns such as release/* work. A project can add branches to this list in .claude/git-guardrails.json, but never remove one.

allow_force_with_lease.title: Allow a plain --force on feature branches
allow_force_with_lease.description: When off, a force push to any branch must use --force-with-lease. Protected branches are blocked either way.

block_commit_on_protected.title: Block commits on protected branches
block_commit_on_protected.description: Turn off for a solo repository where committing on main is the workflow.
